title: A knock during an answer; the user silently goes to the door
description: The user asks for a colourful snack. While the assistant answers, someone knocks; the user walks to the door without a word and opens it (stop). The user talks with the building manager (do not respond), closes the door, walks back and returns to the assistant with two questions (respond).

speech.text: How can I make a colorful snack that needs no cooking?
Hi, I'm the building manager. We're shutting off the water tomorrow morning for a quick repair.
From nine to ten. Could you keep your taps off until we're done?
Thanks for understanding. Have a good evening. Goodbye.
Sorry, where were we with that rainbow snack?
Could I use mango instead of banana in that snack?

assistant.text: Spread plain yogurt on a plate, then arrange soft berries and banana slices into a rainbow. Add a light sprinkle of cinnamon for flavor, and serve it right away.
Arrange berries and banana slices over plain yogurt, then sprinkle on a little cinnamon.
Yes, soft, ripe mango slices work well and add a bright yellow stripe.
